objective: A complete beginner can choose songs, hear an excellent suggested EDM mix, adjust choices, and export; user control is preserved.
completion_requires: Current source, appropriate tests, native UI checks, audio listening evaluation, and OS validation for the scope of each requirement. This list is a scope record, not proof of completion.

Phrase and section detection with musical cue suggestions
Protect vocals, builds, drops and user-locked song moments
Local key analysis of actual overlaps including tails
Detect competing vocals and melodies; suggest alternate cues
Suggest drum-only passages with confidence and override
Recommend mix tempo from chosen songs and explain changes
Conservative pitch and tempo preferences with audible comparisons
Evaluate both neighboring transitions before pitch recommendations
Understandable transition strategies, including restrained filter/echo options
Multiple auditionable transition alternatives
Energy, pacing, duration, opener/closer and locks in order suggestions
Transition-local loudness balancing while preserving dynamics
Musical mix starts, endings, fades and tail preservation
Default simple mode and optional advanced controls
Interactive first-mix workflow
Optional self-contained demo project and suitable audio
Reviewable suggested mix with change summary and user locks
Outcome-based labels and clear original-key versus match-key choices
Predictable main mix playback from playhead
Automatic preparation for listening; no mandatory render knowledge
Library audition with seeking, beginning/end listening, no insertion
Direct transition selection, pair labels and both-song highlighting
Overlap stepper, seconds, presets, available-audio limit and edge dragging
Dedicated two-song transition editor with beat/phrase grids and handoff
Transition loop and outgoing/incoming/blend audition
Seamless loudness-matched A/B for pitch and transition alternatives
Review-all-transitions workflow with Keep/Change/Next
Separate calibrated timing, harmonic and overlap-content confidence
Qualified key warnings and actionable alternatives
